findings.desc: doc-code-drift: CHANGELOG.md now has two duplicate ### Experiments headings under ## Unreleased — the B-0c07 entry was prepended with a fresh ### Experiments heading above the existing one rather than inserted beneath it. This creates a malformed changelog structure (two sibling headings of the same name in the same section) that will confuse changelog parsers and readers. No code inconsistency; the content of the entry is accurate.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: removed the duplicate ### Experiments heading; B-0c07 + B-a1b0 bullets now share one heading.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: CHANGELOG.md:9 duplicate `### Experiments` heading — the B-0c07 patch prepended `### Experiments` before the B-0c07 bullet but the section heading already existed at line 5, producing two consecutive `### Experiments` headings in the Unreleased block

[codex-host2 C2] makeRealBareArm: non-JSON / malformed claude -p output is scored as a SUCCESSFUL shipped arm (infraFail:false, shipped:true) instead of infra-fail -> a broken response corrupts the catch-rate. FIX: JSON.parse failure -> infra-fail (shipped:false).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: parseClaudeResult returns infra-fail on JSON.parse failure (non-JSON output no longer scored as shipped). Self-check asserts it.

findings.desc: [codex-host2 C3] makeRealBareArm: a JSON API-error at exit 0 (is_error / Overloaded / 529 / API Error) is scored as a real outcome. recovery-runner guards /Overloaded|API Error|529/; this arm does not. FIX: detect is_error / error-text -> infra-fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: parseClaudeResult flags is_error / non-success subtype / Overloaded|API Error|429|529 result text as infra-fail. Self-check asserts all 3.

findings.desc: [codex-host2 C4] cost/token parsing is type-unsafe: j.total_cost_usd || 0 preserves a string/object (later .toFixed crashes); tokensFromUsage can add non-numbers. FIX: coerce with typeof===number && isFinite guards.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: num() coerces total_cost_usd + token fields (typeof number && isFinite), string cost -> 0. Self-check asserts string cost/tokens coerce to numeric 0.
